name: Negative Space Focused Illustration
prompt: Style: Negative Space Focused Illustration: A deliberately restrained illustration style built on a single confident focal cluster surrounded by vast, empty extent, minimal linework rendering only what's essential to read the subject clearly, a confident economy where the unmarked space carries as much compositional weight as the mark itself, silhouette and shape doing the primary storytelling work rather than internal detail, and a quiet, contemplative elegance that treats emptiness as an active, deliberate compositional partner. Influenced by: minimalist negative-space illustration tradition, Japanese ma compositional philosophy, contemporary editorial silhouette technique, reductive graphic-design practice..
